label: SB-12 connection-storm accept rate: established preface-roundtrips per second
methodology: one server per peer; per repeat, W worker threads loop TCP connect + HTTP/2 preface + server-SETTINGS roundtrip for duration_s, holding a bounded rotating pool (64/worker, oldest closed on evict; plain close, no RST storm); rate = established/wall. 'Established' requires the full preface roundtrip, so the figure is the server accept+handshake-processing rate, not bare TCP SYN acceptance. Cell order is frozen: peers in file order.
claim_host_requirements: Linux; somaxconn / tcp_max_syn_backlog at distro defaults is fine (established-only counting absorbs backlog queueing), RLIMIT_NOFILE comfortably above workers x burst depth; the report embeds the live values and the refused/timeout counters.
os_limit_policy: backlog-full refuses against a live server, or fd/port exhaustion, marks the cell invalid, never fail; only fail exits nonzero.
